nodes.description: Privileged owner address of the Migrations contract, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used by the restricted modifier.
Stores the last completed migration index; written by setCompleted and read by upgrade before being forwarded to an external contract.
Constructor of the Migrations contract; assigns owner = msg.sender at deployment.
Access-control modifier that only executes the body when msg.sender equals the stored owner.
Restricted function that writes the supplied completed value into last_completed_migration.
Restricted function that casts an arbitrary address to Migrations and calls setCompleted on it, forwarding last_completed_migration.
Caller-controlled address read in the constructor and in the restricted modifier.
External call upgraded.setCompleted(last_completed_migration) to an attacker-influenceable address, executed inside upgrade without any reentrancy protection.
Input value supplied to setCompleted and stored in last_completed_migration.
Address supplied to upgrade and used as the target of the external Migrations call.
Local Migrations instance created from new_address inside upgrade; used as the receiver of the external call.

edges.reason: The constructor assigns owner from msg.sender, establishing the privileged account that gates restricted functions.
The restricted modifier compares msg.sender against owner to decide whether the guarded function body runs.
setCompleted is guarded by the restricted modifier, so execution depends on the msg.sender/owner check.
upgrade is guarded by the restricted modifier, so execution depends on the msg.sender/owner check.
The completed parameter is the input argument consumed by setCompleted.
setCompleted stores the caller-supplied completed value into the last_completed_migration state variable.
last_completed_migration is read and forwarded as an argument to the untrusted external call before any reentrancy protection.
upgrade creates the local Migrations instance upgraded from the supplied address.
The user-supplied new_address becomes the callee of the external call, letting an attacker choose the invoked contract.
The local upgraded instance is the receiver of the external setCompleted call, which may run attacker-controlled code.
upgrade unconditionally transfers control to the attacker-influenceable external contract through upgraded.setCompleted.
The attacker-controlled callee can reenter upgrade (and other functions) after last_completed_migration is read, since no reentrancy guard exists.

normalization_plan.reason: The completed parameter is only used as the value written by setCompleted, so it can be absorbed into that core function node.
The new_address parameter is only consumed inside upgrade to build the callee, so it can be merged into the upgrade function node.
The local variable upgraded only exists inside upgrade as the external-call receiver and has no independent semantic identity.
